items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Progressing in recovery
items.text:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Egbuka (concussion/foot) took part in individual drills Wednesday, but the wide receiver will need to do more Thursday to progress toward a return to action, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: On field to begin Week 8 prep
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) was spotted on the field for the start of Wednesday's practice, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Returning to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said that Rice (hamstring/knee) is expected to practice Wednesday, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Sitting out, but will be full go Thursday
items.text:
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Diggs won't practice Wednesday due to an unspecified issue but is expected to be a full participant Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Sitting out practice due to shoulder issue
items.text:
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate won't practice Wednesday due to a shoulder injury, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
